title: Multicenter randomized clinical trial to evaluate two different amiodarone regimens to maintain sinus rhythm after cardioversion in persistent atrial fibrillation (PERIVERSION-2).
official: Multicenter randomized clinical trial to evaluate two different amiodarone regimens to maintain sinus rhythm after cardioversion in persistent atrial fibrillation (PERIVERSION-2).
summary: Main objective: To compare the efficacy in maintaining sinus rhythm 12 months post electrical cardioversion between standard (200 mg/d) and reduced (100 mg/d) doses of amiodarone in patients with persistent atrial fibrillation.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients aged ≥ 18 ye
2. Documented persistent atrial fibrillation (≥ 7 days in duration)
3. Electively referred for Electrical Cardioversion under amiodarone treatment
4. Signed informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Urgent electrical cardioversion
2. Significant left ventricular hypertrophy (wall thickness ≥ 15mm)
3. Hyperthyroidism or hypothyroidism
4. Known hepatobiliary disease (acute hepatitis, cirrhosis...) or ALT/AST > 3 x upper limit of normal (ULN)
5. Allergy, intolerance, or known hypersensitivity to study medications
6. Patients with contraindications to amiodarone, such as uncontrolled thyroid dysfunction, severe sinus bradycardia, second- or third-degree AV block without a pacemaker, and a history of amiodarone-induced pulmonary toxicity.
7. Women of childbearing potential unwilling to use contraceptive measures and breastfeeding women.
8. Participation in another clinical trial involving investigational drugs
9. Life expectancy less than 12 months
10. Rheumatic mitral stenosis of any degree or severe mitral or aortic valve dysfunction.
11. Atrial fibrillation post-cardiac surgery
12. Previous myocardial infarction
13. New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class IV heart failure
14. Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) <45%
